name: XCC_TR_HEADERS
description: This table stores the transaction header attributes calling the budgetary control engine. There are foreign keys back to the calling subledger or general ledger transaction.  Funds check calls maybe purged from this table.

columns.name: HEADER_NUM
columns.description: Unique identifier for this transaction.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Identifies the type of transaction.

columns.name: SOURCE_HEADER_ID_1
columns.description: Subledger or General Ledger transaction primary key.

columns.name: SOURCE_HEADER_ID_2
columns.description: Subledger or General Ledger transaction primary key.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_NUMBER
columns.description: This columns contains the transaction number.

columns.name: SOURCE_ACTION_CODE
columns.description: Subledger commitment control action.  Valid values depend upon the subledger and transaction type involved.

columns.name: DATA_SET_ID
columns.description: Identifies the budgetary control transaction or group of transactions processed in a run.

columns.name: RESULT_CODE
columns.description: Status of the budgetary control transaction.

columns.name: ARRIVAL_ORDER
columns.description: If multiple transactions are being processed at once, order in which they should be considered.

columns.name: DRAFT_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether this funds activity was attempted in draft mode or final mode.  Funds activities attempted in draft mode do not reserve funds.  They just check to see whether the funds activity would have passed.

columns.name: BUDGET_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether or not this is a budget transaction.

columns.name: OVERRIDE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if this transaction was overridden.

columns.name: LEDGER_ID
columns.description: Ledger associated with this transaction, it is NULL for GL and XLA, as the ledger is a line level attribute there.  It is also NULL for budgets.

columns.name: BUSINESS_UNIT_ID
columns.description: Business unit of this transaction, it is only populated here when the transaction type or action does not support distribution level BUs.

columns.name: DESTINATION_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Destination type is either Expense or Inventory.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_SOURCE_CODE
columns.description: Transaction source code is populated for projects only.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Document type code is populated for projects only.

columns.name: JE_SOURCE_CODE
columns.description: General ledger journal source is populated for GL and XLA data only.

columns.name: LIQUIDATION_DATE_CODE
columns.description: Method via which the liquidation date should be obtained, it is used for PPM.

columns.name: PARTIAL_RESERVATION_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if partial reservations are allowed.

columns.name: DATA_PURGED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates that one or more lines have been purged for this transaction. Valid values are Y and N.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OVERRIDABLE_CODE
columns.description: Indicates what type of override is available when running in override or override check mode.

columns.name: HEADER_GROUP_CODE
columns.description: Used to control whether multiple transactions should be grouped together for purposes of budegtary control. If provided, any transactions with the same value for this column will pass or fail budgetary control as a unit.

columns.name: FAILURE_REASON_CODE
columns.description: Reason for failure when budgetary control failed for some reason other than a failed budgetary control activity. Some potential reasons are: failure of related transactions, or a burdening failure.

columns.name: SUCCESS_REASON_CODE
columns.description: Reason for success when no budgetary control activity was generated. Potential success reasons are: budgetary control not being applicable, or no control budgets being applicable for this transaction. A transaction may still fail budgetary control, if a related transaction fails.
